scripts.check: node --check worker/src/protocol.mjs && node --check worker/src/index.mjs && node --check scripts/build-pages.mjs
scripts.dev:pages: node scripts/build-pages.mjs --signal-origin=ws://localhost:8787 && wrangler pages dev dist/pages --port 8788
scripts.deploy:pages: node scripts/build-pages.mjs --require-secure --signal-path-prefix=/_nw && wrangler pages deploy dist/pages --project-name navonweb-web-staging
